item.title: Taranum
item.description: Taranum, a Naat singing competition show produced by Lemar TV will soon start to broadcast. The show introduces the best Afghan Naat, Munajaat and Gnostic Poem readers, who will participate from diffrent parts of the country and only the best out of hundreds will be selected for the qualification rounds. Stay tuned and watch the first episode of the show on the first day of Ramadan only on Lemar TV.
